content.short: Apillon Embedded Wallet Service is a comprehensive Web3 platform that simplifies blockchain development.
content.description: Apillon Embedded Wallet Service provides an embedded wallet solution that streamlines Web3 onboarding by taking care of wallet creation, security, and ongoing management behind the scenes. It leverages passkey authentication to add a convenient layer of protection. Users can freely access and interact with decentralized applications without handling private keys or mnemonics, as these secrets are securely stored and encrypted using their passkey.
